assessment_reason: Moderate icing at cruise altitude near Geneva with no escape below freezing level, but IFR flight path is viable and icing is limited to the final segment.
synoptic: A weakening frontal system crossing from the Atlantic brings moisture and lower freezing levels across the Channel and into the Alps. High pressure to the north limits the extent.
specific_concerns: Alpine approach to Geneva — freezing level drops to 3800ft with moderate rime icing up to 8200ft. Terrain limits escape options below the freezing level. ICON shows the most aggressive icing (moderate-severe).
trend: Deterioration from yesterday's GREEN — frontal system bringing icing risk that was not present 24h ago.
watch_items: Monitor freezing level evolution — if it drops further, icing escape becomes impossible. Check ICON vs GFS/ECMWF convergence on icing severity.
